sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Use Ki? and *Hol*? with the familiar forms to keep a short introduction going.

items.english: Who are you? Where do you live?

sections.content: Stacking Ki? and Hol? back to back mirrors how the answers arrived in the last lesson — question order tends to match answer order in a good exchange. If you can ask both questions in one breath, you’re ready for your first real two-line conversation in Hungarian.
